dataPreservation: No user focus was cancelled; the visible prior session was completed before testing
Free-focus tests did not edit user plans, goals, rest dates or allowlist
No uninstall, data clear, database export, system-time change, permission reset, reboot or clear-all-recents
Completed and cancelled test records are retained; existing visible history and pet remained available

toolingAndInterruptedAttempts: Incoming call deferred UI operations; no call handled or made by this test

Earlier lock observations were interrupted by wake or unlock and are excluded from the accepted 20-minute interval

limitations: This handset, firmware and required settings only; other brands and firmware remain unverified
Genuine force stop, revoked accessibility, reboot and clear-all-recents were not tested
USB-powered lock sampling does not establish deep-idle behavior, battery consumption or multi-day stability
Periodic status/window sampling does not establish zero gaps or pure app-interception latency
Protection was last sampled running at 15:56:49 and first sampled stopped at 15:58:30; exact expiry release latency was not measured
Fresh session expired during long lock; live visible-reminder removal at its deadline uses prior 0.2.7 evidence, not a new observation here
New-session blocking and two-step exit were tested after long-lock expiry; active blocking at the end of the original locked session is not claimed
